classification: Original game/film production concepts; not screenshots or verified application outputs.

sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a flagship creative-software website showcase, 16:9 wide landscape, 2048x1152. Create an extraordinarily accomplished AAA game environment concept with the realism and compositional sophistication of a premium game art portfolio. An original vast overgrown mountain citadel above a turquoise glacial gorge: monumental weathered stone terraces, a narrow suspended stone bridge crossing the gorge in the midground, remnants of subtle ancient mechanical architecture, trees rooted into the ruins, mist and waterfalls far below. A single small original traveler seen from behind on a stone path in the lower foreground gives believable human scale; no recognizable franchise costumes. Camera at human eye level, not isometric, not a miniature, a fully inhabitable world. Clear foreground-midground-background depth, tangible weathered surfaces, detailed foliage, fine geological strata, realistic natural daylight breaking through distant cloud with restrained volumetric rays. Sophisticated palette of mineral blues, forest greens, limestone and a small warm amber cloth accent. The gorgeous far citadel is the focal point, compose thoughtfully across the entire wide frame with a readable silhouette at thumbnail size. Physically based game-cinematic render, film-grade detail, believable perspective and subtle atmosphere. This is an original illustrative production concept, not a software screenshot or an existing game. No text, typography, labels, logos, UI, HUD, cursor, interface panels, split panels, arrows, progress diagrams, borders, watermarks, copyrighted recognizable game content, low-poly toy-like geometry, stylized miniature diorama or cartoon proportions.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a flagship creative-software website showcase, 16:9 wide landscape, 2048x1152. Create an original visually stunning feature-film VFX shot, production-concept artwork, photoreal and physically grounded. A monumental experimental circular energy aperture is being activated inside a huge abandoned industrial launch hall at night. Complex original mechanical ring built from plausible layered metal ribs and cables, fractured dark architecture, rainwater and reflective puddles on the concrete floor. The energy in the aperture is turbulent luminous golden-white plasma with beautifully resolved filament motion, a controlled scattering of sparks and light debris, and atmospheric volume interacting with the structure. Two very small unrecognizable crew silhouettes in grounded work clothing stand far from the machine for scale. Camera low at 28mm equivalent, cinematic wide shot, strong depth and a carefully framed focal ring rather than a graphic circle. Cool steel and charcoal architecture, motivated amber-white light from the aperture, exceptionally realistic shadowing, material texture, subtle wet reflections and airborne haze. The special effects must feel part of a photographed live-action plate, not a fantasy infographic or a neon wallpaper. Expensive film production design and outstanding compositing finish, controlled exposure, no blown highlights, beautiful detail visible at small viewing size. This is an original illustrative production concept, not an actual software render verification or film still. No text, numbers, logos, studio marks, UI, application screenshots, HUD, split panels, before-and-after panels, arrows, decorative grids, watermark, recognizable movie franchise designs, purple cyberpunk glow, floating screens, toy or miniature look.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a flagship creative-software website showcase, 16:9 wide landscape, 2048x1152. Create an original photoreal high-end game and film character look-development presentation that feels like an exceptional character artist portfolio rather than a product advertisement. A compelling original mature female frontier explorer, waist-up three-quarter portrait, with expressive believable face, subtly weathered freckled skin, dark hair tied back in practical braids, a beautifully crafted graphite and oxidized bronze technical shoulder plate over a deep forest-green woven jacket, restrained leather straps, fine stitching, tiny wear and realistic material roughness. No weapon and no recognizable actor or franchise. Character occupies the right and center of the frame; on the left is a softer, believable workshop background with a single out-of-focus sculptural armor piece, not a UI and not a labeled material sphere layout. Warm raking key light, soft cool rim, cinematic neutral background, beautiful sophisticated skin subsurface scattering, natural eye reflections, controlled realistic hair flyaways, extraordinary fabric and metal surface fidelity. Subtle atmospheric depth, lifelike expression with quiet determination, visibly professional digital character production. A single coherent image, not a contact sheet or multiple viewpoints. Strong readable subject, generous safe framing around the head and shoulders; horizontal 16:9 composition. This is an original illustrative production concept, not a verified output from software, an existing game character or a photograph of a real person. Absolutely no text, letters, logos, software UI, overlays, HUD, labels, frames, arrows, watermarks, visible tools in hands, sexualized costume, cartoon proportions, toy figures, plastic skin, glossy beauty-retouch aesthetic or saturated neon.
